positions.summary_short: Salonen favours managed growth guided by the new Official Plan and negotiated outcomes with builders.
summary_bullets: Supports planning for growth 'on our terms' within provincial planning rules, using new Official Plan frameworks to guide development.
Points to negotiated barrier-free homes in new Baden and New Hamburg neighbourhoods to support aging in place.
positions.verbatim_quote: Growth is not something Wilmot controls alone.
positions.source_title: 2026 Election — Re-Elect Natasha Salonen, Mayor of Wilmot

positions.summary_short: Salonen frames affordability as long-term financial sustainability through zero-based budgeting, rebuilt reserves, and tax-base growth.
summary_bullets: Argues affordability is more than the tax bill: predictable taxation, long-term financial planning, and growing the tax base.
Directed a KPMG zero-based budgeting review of operating spending and is rebuilding reserves under a 2025 commitment to raise capital/reserve investment 9% per year for three years.
Her 2026 township budget proposed a 9.7% property tax increase with 5% water and 6% wastewater rate increases.
positions.verbatim_quote: Affordability is more than a tax bill.
positions.source_title: 2026 Election — Re-Elect Natasha Salonen, Mayor of Wilmot

positions.summary_short: Salonen emphasizes lifecycle-based asset management and a strong Wilmot voice in regional water supply decisions.
summary_bullets: Strengthened asset management so roads, bridges, facilities and parks decisions are based on condition, lifespan and replacement cost.
On water: wants fair treatment for residents affected by municipal well interference and long-term, evidence-based decisions in the Region's Water Supply Strategy through 2051.
positions.verbatim_quote: Infrastructure is about more than building something new.
positions.source_title: 2026 Election — Re-Elect Natasha Salonen, Mayor of Wilmot

positions.summary_short: Salonen pledges to represent Wilmot strongly at the Region and with other governments, rooted in representative democracy.
summary_bullets: Emphasizes representative democracy: listening to perspectives, weighing evidence and professional advice, and exercising judgment.
Pledges strong representation for Wilmot at Regional Council and with provincial and federal governments; serves on the boards of AMO and ROMA.
positions.verbatim_quote: A strong voice requires strong relationships.
positions.source_title: 2026 Election — Re-Elect Natasha Salonen, Mayor of Wilmot

positions.summary_short: Goertz calls for thoughtful, planned growth that protects farmland, water and Wilmot's rural character.
summary_bullets: Priority: 'Thoughtful, Planned Growth' — deciding where, how, and if Wilmot should grow.
Protecting farmland, water and rural character; supports employment lands and complete communities.
positions.verbatim_quote: Where, how, and if we should grow.
positions.source_title: Stephanie Goertz | Candidate for Mayor of Wilmot Township

positions.summary_short: Goertz pledges to protect farmland, groundwater, private wells, natural areas and green infrastructure.
summary_bullets: Priority: 'Protection of our Environment' — what Wilmot needs to protect and strengthen.
Focus areas: farmland, groundwater, private wells, natural areas and green infrastructure.
positions.verbatim_quote: What we need to protect and strengthen.
positions.source_title: Stephanie Goertz | Candidate for Mayor of Wilmot Township

positions.summary_short: Goertz promises transparent financial planning with 10-year horizons and value-for-money spending.
summary_bullets: Priority: 'Transparent Financial Planning' — regular, easy-to-read financial plans.
Approach: increase economic development, 10-year planning, value for money.
positions.verbatim_quote: How will we pay for it?
positions.source_title: Stephanie Goertz | Candidate for Mayor of Wilmot Township

positions.summary_short: Goertz lists reliable services and infrastructure — roads, fire services, water/wastewater, parks — as a campaign priority.
summary_bullets: Priority: 'Reliable Services & Infrastructure' — how Wilmot repairs and builds the community.
Covers roads, community centres, recreation, fire services, water/wastewater, infrastructure and parks.
positions.verbatim_quote: How do we repair and build our community
positions.source_title: Stephanie Goertz | Candidate for Mayor of Wilmot Township

positions.summary_short: Goertz promises regional and provincial advocacy and a council that works together.
summary_bullets: Priority: 'A Strong Voice for Wilmot' — leadership that makes a difference.
Regional and provincial advocacy, stronger partnerships, bringing council together, standing up for Wilmot's interests.
positions.source_title: Stephanie Goertz | Candidate for Mayor of Wilmot Township

positions.summary_short: Wilkinson pledges fiscal responsibility with tax increases tied to inflation.
summary_bullets: Platform pillar: Fiscal Responsibility.
Keeping tax increases predictable by tying them to inflation, finding efficiencies, and respecting every tax dollar.

positions.summary_short: Wilkinson promises investment in roads, parks, recreation and community spaces.
summary_bullets: Platform pillar: Strong Communities.
Investing in roads, parks, recreation, community spaces and local services that strengthen quality of life.
positions.verbatim_quote: Investing in roads, parks, recreation, community spaces, and local services that strengthen our quality of life.

positions.summary_short: Wilkinson pledges open, transparent government with a stronger council role.
summary_bullets: Platform pillar: Transparent & Democratic Government.
Leading openly, strengthening Council's role, and ensuring residents are informed, engaged and represented; 'listen before I decide' and explain major decisions clearly.
positions.verbatim_quote: Leading openly, strengthening Council’s role, and ensuring residents are informed, engaged, and represented.

positions.summary_short: Wilkinson backs responsible growth planning, business attraction and a stronger tax base.
summary_bullets: Platform pillar: Smart Growth & Economic Opportunity.
Planning responsibly for growth while attracting businesses and strengthening the tax base.
positions.verbatim_quote: Planning responsibly for growth while attracting businesses and strengthening our tax base.

positions.summary_short: Wilkinson promises to protect Wilmot's water and advocate for taxpayers.
summary_bullets: Platform pillar: A Strong Voice for Wilmot.
Protecting Wilmot's water, advocating for taxpayers, and ensuring Wilmot's interests come first.
positions.verbatim_quote: Protecting our water, advocating for taxpayers, and ensuring Wilmot’s interests come first.
